fields.summary: Customer can sign in with email and password
fields.description: As a Registered Customer, I want to sign in with my email address and password so that I can view my accounts.
fields.acceptance_criteria: Given an active account, when the customer submits a correct email and password, then the accounts overview is displayed.

fields.summary: Account locks after five failed sign-in attempts
fields.description: Brute-force protection required by the security review.
fields.acceptance_criteria: Given an active account, when the customer submits an incorrect password five times in a row, then the account is locked for 30 minutes and a lockout notice is displayed.

fields.summary: Unregistered email must not be disclosed
fields.description: Account enumeration was raised in the last penetration test.
fields.acceptance_criteria: When the customer submits an email address that is not registered, then a generic invalid credentials message is shown and account existence is not disclosed.

fields.summary: Password reset link expires after 30 minutes
fields.description: As a Registered Customer, I want an expired reset link to be refused so that an intercepted email cannot be reused.
fields.acceptance_criteria: Given a reset link issued more than 30 minutes ago, when the customer opens it, then the link is rejected as expired and a new link can be requested.

fields.summary: New password must be at least 12 characters
fields.description: Aligns with the updated password policy.
fields.acceptance_criteria: Given a valid reset link, when the customer submits a new password of at least 12 characters, then the password is updated and all other sessions are signed out.

fields.summary: Customer can transfer funds between their own accounts
fields.description: As a Registered Customer, I want to move money between my accounts so that I can manage my balances.
fields.acceptance_criteria: Given two active accounts, when the customer transfers an amount within the available balance, then both balances are updated and a confirmation reference is displayed.

fields.summary: Transfer is rejected when funds are insufficient
fields.description: Overdraft is not supported in this release.
fields.acceptance_criteria: Given a source account with a balance below the transfer amount, when the customer submits the transfer, then the transfer is rejected and no balance changes.

fields.summary: Transfer amount must be greater than zero
fields.description: A zero-value transfer currently produces a confirmation screen with no reference number.
fields.acceptance_criteria: When the transfer amount is zero or negative, then submission is blocked with a field-level validation message.

fields.summary: Amount is a mandatory field on the transfer form
fields.description: The amount field must be completed before a transfer can be submitted.
fields.acceptance_criteria: Given the transfer form is displayed, when the customer submits it without an amount, then submission is blocked and the amount field is reported as required.

fields.summary: Audit log is restricted to administrator accounts
fields.description: As an Administrator, I want the audit log restricted to administrator accounts so that customer data stays protected.
fields.acceptance_criteria: Given a standard-role customer, when they navigate directly to /admin, then an access-denied response is returned and no audit data is rendered.

fields.summary: Administrator can open the audit log
fields.acceptance_criteria: Given an administrator account, when they open /admin, then the audit log is displayed with the most recent entries first.

fields.summary: Customer can download a statement for a date range
fields.description: As a Registered Customer, I want to download a statement so that I can keep my own records.
fields.acceptance_criteria: Given at least one transaction, when the customer requests a statement for a date range, then a statement containing only that customer's transactions is downloaded.

fields.description: The statements screen should be faster and handle large date ranges appropriately. Users have complained. TBD what the target is.
fields.acceptance_criteria: Statements should load quickly and behave properly, etc.

fields.summary: Customer can control which emails they receive
fields.description: As a Registered Customer, I want to control which emails I receive so that I am not spammed.
